description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various fine-tuned models on the Whisper abstractive summarization task, with the x-axis representing the training epoch (ranging from 0 to 6) and the y-axis showing the Word Error Rate (WER), which ranges from approximately 30 to 70. The legend identifies five different model configurations: "tiny AdaLoRA_int4", "tiny AdaLoRA_int8", "tiny int4", "tiny int8", and "tiny full". The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" model (solid line with square markers) starts at a WER of about 60 and shows a general downward trend, ending near 50. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" model (dashed line with square markers) begins at a WER of approximately 60 and decreases to around 50. The "tiny int4" model (dotted line with circle markers) starts at a WER of about 65 and declines to roughly 50. The "tiny int8" model (dashed line with circle markers) begins at a WER of approximately 60 and decreases to around 50. The "tiny full" model (dotted line with triangle markers) starts at a WER of about 30 and remains relatively stable, ending near 40. All models show a decrease in WER as the number of epochs increases, with the "tiny full" model consistently achieving the lowest WER throughout the training process.
